{{Quote|Ur'Laoch preferred to decapitate victims... with his ''teeth''.|From Laurita Tohm's report on the Prism Riot|<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />}}
'''Ur'Loach''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]], serving the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was considered to be an enforcer of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. During the war, Ur'Loach was captured by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] near the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]]. He was then imprisoned within [[The Prism]], along with other prisoners deemed highly dangerous by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the subsequent [[Ghost Prison incident|Gentis coup]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Trachta]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]] traveled to the Prism in order to find a safe haven where they could heal the mortally wounded [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Since they believed they could not trust anyone within the Empire, Ur'Loach was released and became part of a [[Mission to the Prism|brutal test]] created by Vader, to see who among the prisoners was worthy of joining the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />

During the battle, Ur'Loach attacked Lieutenant Tohm and overpowered him, grabbing the human's arm and [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in his hands and wrapping his long, prehensile tongue around Tohm's neck. Ur'Loach drew Tohm closer, knocking the blaster away and planning on biting the young man's head off, as was his wont. Ur'Loach didn't see fellow Separatist and prisoner [[Shonn Volta]], who [[Telekinesis/Legends|drew]] Tohm's blaster to herself with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. With a single shot, she hit Ur'Loach right in his open mouth, bisecting his head and [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />
